title: Localized metric scrubber + keyboard pivot for Route Overview (WCAG + i18n readiness)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Scope: update the Route Overview metric scrubber (time-series hover scrubber and summary pane) to meet WCAG AA contrast and keyboard semantics and make it fully localized. Work covers color token adjustments, aria patterns for scrubber and pivot controls, RTL layout sanity, numeric/date localization, and a small compact design variant used in tight layouts. This ticket contains the design spec, prototype links, review notes, and acceptance criteria for handoff to engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Scrubber thumb and active timeline region meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background at all token scales

All interactive elements (scrubber thumb, left/right pivot buttons, summary pane actions) reachable and operable with keyboard only using standard arrow/tab patterns and roving tabindex where appropriate
Screen-reader announces timeline position as localized date/time and value using aria-live politeness set to polite during scrubber movement
Number formats in summary pane follow user locale (grouping, decimal separator) and unit shorthand (e.g., 1.2k) localized where language requires different pluralization rules
RTL layout flips scrubber correctly and preserves focus order; no visual overlap or clipping on supported locales
Compact variant fits within 280px width without truncation and retains accessible hit target sizes (min 44px)
notes: We are consolidating color token usage: token-neutral-600 should become token-neutral-700 for timeline base to satisfy contrast at small sizes
Prefer using CSS logical properties (inset-inline-start/end) for scrubber positioning to reduce RTL layout bugs

Avoid custom role implementations for sliders; use native input[type=range] only when it can meet design; otherwise implement an ARIA slider pattern with focusable scrubber and keyboard event handling consistent with WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices
review_feedback: PM (Lina Alvarez): ensure the summary pane content is configurable by route; add a label for ‘sampled’ vs ‘total’ when sampling applied

Engineering (Leo Martins): prefer providing a minimal JS accessibility util for announcing localized values rather than ad-hoc aria-live snippets; requested prototype test cases with NVDA/VO on Windows and Safari with VoiceOver
Design (Sofia Ruiz): suggest larger focus ring token for high-contrast mode and a separate visual for 'disabled' state when data not available
implementation_tasks: Update color tokens and create theme migration doc (frontend) - PR #4589
Implement keyboard pivot interactions and roving tabindex for scrubber - branch feat/scrubber-keynav
Integrate i18n formatting util for numbers/dates; add unit localization table - i18n PR #627
Add RTL QA checklist and automated visual tests for LTR/RTL permutations
qa_checklist: Contrast audit using Axe and manual 4.5:1 verification at 12px and 14px weights
Keyboard-only walkthrough covering tab, shift+tab, arrow left/right, page up/down for scrubber granularity
VoiceOver/NVDA read-through of timeline announcements and summary pane updates
Locale smoke tests: en-US, fr-FR, ar-SA, zh-CN verifying number/date formatting and layout flips
Resize to compact variant and verify hit targets and truncation behavior
decisions: Use aria-live polite for incremental updates during dragging; announce final value with assertive politeness when scrub ends
Implement localized shorthand units via i18n table maintained by product in the console i18n repo
Adopt CSS logical properties and avoid absolute left/right pixel offsets to simplify RTL behavior
dependencies: PM-4412 (route metadata config for summary pane)
next_steps: Share prototype with accessibility guild and schedule NVDA/VO pairing session (target week of 2025-03-03)
Create engineering RFC for scrubber keyboard API and telemetry events
Add the updated color tokens to the theming migration checklist and communicate to component library owners
